event.text: Please call 911 now for an ambulance and do not try to stand or walk on that leg. A fall with severe hip pain and inability to put weight on the leg in someone your age can mean a broken hip, which needs emergency imaging and orthopedic care today; X-rays can look normal, so hands-on assessment is essential. If you develop faintness, confusion or worsening pain while waiting, tell the 911 dispatcher.
